question: does the measured compatibility/quality trade-off between independently trained conditionals and one shared conditional network remain when the two arms get the same process-CPU training budget (R7 matched update counts, not CPU)? Not a test of joint coherence of the shared network.

estimator_check.verdict: NO ESTIMATOR OR LEAKAGE DEFECT FOUND: denominators n(n-1)/m(m-1) with the diagon

seeds_note: initialization, minibatch-stream and dev-loss-noise seeds are the R7 integers, reused unchanged; only the stopping rule differs (CPU budget instead of 20000 updates)

training.unit: process CPU seconds of this single-thread process measured with time.process_time(), per arm: the whole independent ensemble (4 networks, balanced round-robin) and the whole shared network
training.stop: after the first full update at which the arm's CPU use >= 60.0 s (overshoot recorded); final iterate only; no checkpoint selection
training.warmup: 20 updates on a throwaway model of the same class (seed 999) before each arm type; identical for both arms; not charged to the arm budget; recorded
training.matching: approximate OS-level CPU matching, not exact FLOP matching

data.dev: unchanged rows; used only for the end-of-training held-out loss diagnostic

rng: seed_v2 hash over {experiment, joint, split='test_r8', replicate, arm, pattern, example, branch, sample_id, purpose}; step count excluded so 128/512 share initial noise; direct and sequential on disjoint streams; fresh y per z sample

solver.rule: fixed before the run; no permutation test at 512; nothing selected by outcome

evaluation.test: Test P at 128 (mean ED_V, upper tail)
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Theta_128 = mean_i mean_r [ED_U(shared)_ri - ED_U(independent)_ri] at the target level; cluster bootstrap over examples carrying all pairs/arms/solvers; per-replicate contrasts and range shown; 4 x 200 not pooled

families.joint: 8 joint tests at 128, Holm, separate secondary

evaluation.quality: direct and sequential sample ED_U to the true conditional, sd ratios, mean shifts; cost: updates reached, exposure, parameters, CPU and wall
evaluation.comparison_with_R7: descriptive only (different test sets; design seen before); not an independent causal or equal-everything comparison

stop_conditions: non-finite losses or samples (arm labelled INCONCLUSIVE; run continues)
bug_policy: an engineering bug keeps the original result as INVALID with its scope; one minimal fix and one re-run of the affected stage at most; protocol/estimand changes stop the run
